notes: Modified cash basis school district; governmental funds only (no enterprise funds; Nutrition is a governmental fund here). Statement lines taken from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4-p6). Beginning/ending cash = beginning/ending fund balances of that statement (cash basis, equal to cash plus cash at county treasurers on p6). The statement's General Fund column also contains the Depreciation Fund and Employee Benefit Fund (General Fund schedule ending balance 2,889,187 + 185,413 + 214,805 = 3,289,405). Splits with split_from: Other local receipts 20,010 (license fees 2,725 + summer school fees 6,350 + misc 10,935), County receipts 45,292 (fines 43,464 + other county 1,828), State receipts 4,579,715 (nameplate capacity tax 5,358 as other taxes + remainder), Non-revenue receipts 8,780 (capital lease proceeds 702 as debt_proceeds, which the printed receipts total includes + other non-revenue 8,078), Student support services 1,242,842 (General Fund 454,673 + Activities Fund 788,169 as student activities). Roll-forward: 4,853,203 + (11,105,089 - 702) - 11,672,474 + 100,000 - 100,000 + 702 + 10,840 = 4,296,658. Transfers in 100,000 = Activities 20,000 + Nutrition 80,000; transfers out 100,000 from the General Fund column. Detail: only budget-and-actual schedules for each fund exist (no program-by-object Exhibit N), so General Fund lines are 'not itemized' by program; the Student Activities schedule is a one-line fund schedule. Transfer cross-check: Employee Benefit Fund shows 109,337 transfers in from the General Fund, Activities 20,000, Nutrition 80,000; the General Fund schedule shows only 8000 Transfers 100,000 (Activities + Nutrition), so the 109,337 to Employee Benefit is hidden inside General Fund spending (statement merges the funds and eliminates it; General Fund spending lines for instruction, state categorical and federal programs tie to the statement's Instruction only after removing it). Recorded as one contra line (-109,337, instruction group) and an other financing line (-109,337), both with review. General Fund detail_totals include the printed 100,000 transfers in spending (includes other financing). The Special Building 5320 sale of property (10,840) is inside that schedule's printed total receipts, so it is kept as revenue detail (sale of assets); the statement shows it under other financing. 5690 Other non-revenue receipts 8,078 and misc local receipts are unexplained (review). Statement of Activities (p1-2) general receipts lines not used as separate items.
